routes.name: Route A: School (11-12 Science) → Engineering Degree (B.Tech/B.E.)
routes.summary: Standard academic route offering widest university choices and direct eligibility for top national institutes (IITs, NITs, BITS, State Govt colleges).
routes.suitability: Ideal for students comfortable with mathematics and physics who want campus placement opportunities in top tech firms.

steps.course: Class 10 Board Examination (CBSE / ICSE / State Board)
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 10 with minimum 50-60% aggregate and strong foundation in Mathematics and Science.
steps.whatToDo: Collect Class 10 marksheets and apply for Class 11 Science admission in Junior College or Higher Secondary School.

steps.course: Class 11 & 12 Science with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM)
steps.eligibility: Must study PCM. Target minimum 75% aggregate in Class 12 boards to meet JoSAA eligibility for IITs/NITs (65% for SC/ST), or 50% for State CETs.
steps.whatToDo: Master Class 11 and 12 NCERT concepts thoroughly. Solve previous years' question papers (PYQs) and take weekly mock tests for JEE Main and State CET.

steps.course: Seat Allocation via JoSAA / CSAB / State DTE Centralized Admission Process (CAP)
steps.eligibility: Valid rank in JEE Main / State CET + fulfillment of 12th board marks percentage criteria.
steps.whatToDo: Register on centralized counselling portals (JoSAA for IITs/NITs/IIITs, MahaCET CAP for Maharashtra, KCET for Karnataka), submit verified college choices, and secure seat.

steps.course: B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science / Information Technology / Software Engineering
steps.eligibility: Admitted through merit / CET rank into AICTE-approved engineering college.
steps.whatToDo: Maintain 7.5+ CGPA. Master Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA), Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Databases (SQL/NoSQL), and Computer Networks. Build 3-4 production projects on GitHub.

steps.course: Summer Internship & Campus Recruitment / Direct Job Applications
steps.eligibility: Active enrolled student in 6th-8th semester with good academic standing.
steps.whatToDo: Crack on-campus placement coding assessments, participate in hackathons (Smart India Hackathon), contribute to open source, and interview for Software Development Engineer (SDE-1) roles.

routes.name: Route B: Polytechnic Diploma (3 Yrs) → Direct 2nd Year B.Tech (Lateral Entry)
routes.summary: Hands-on technical diploma right after Class 10 followed by lateral-entry admission into 2nd year B.Tech, bypassing Class 11-12 and JEE stress.
routes.suitability: Best for students who prefer early practical laboratory work over abstract Class 11-12 theory.

steps.course: Class 10 Board Examination (Pass with Math & Science)
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 10 with minimum 35-50% marks as required by State DTE polytechnic rules.
steps.whatToDo: Apply through State Directorate of Technical Education (DTE) centralized polytechnic admission rounds.

steps.course: 3-Year Polytechnic Diploma in Computer Engineering / Information Technology
steps.eligibility: Admitted via 10th merit into AICTE/MSBTE approved polytechnic institution.
steps.whatToDo: Learn hands-on programming (C, C++, Java, Web tech), computer hardware, operating systems, and networking. Score 70%+ in final year diploma for high lateral entry cutoff.

steps.course: Direct Second Year (DSE) Admission into B.E. / B.Tech (3rd Semester)
steps.eligibility: Pass 3-year AICTE diploma with minimum 45% aggregate (40% for reserved categories). Seats are subject to 10% lateral entry supernumerary quota and vacancy rules.

entranceExams.name: State Lateral Entry CAP / CET (e.g. DTE DSE Maharashtra, JELET WB)

steps.whatToDo: Register for centralized Direct Second Year (DSE) counselling, submit diploma scores, and enter directly into year 2 of B.E./B.Tech.

steps.course: Complete Years 2, 3, and 4 of B.E./B.Tech
steps.eligibility: Enrolled in 2nd year B.Tech through lateral entry.
steps.whatToDo: Catch up on Engineering Mathematics 3, build advanced cloud and web applications, maintain competitive CGPA, and secure internships.

steps.course: Full-Time Software Engineer / Associate Developer Role
steps.eligibility: Successful B.E./B.Tech graduation with verified project portfolio.
steps.whatToDo: Participate in campus drives, off-campus referrals, and technical coding rounds for software developer positions.

routes.name: Route C: School (11-12 Any Stream) → BCA / B.Sc Computer Science → Tech Industry or MCA
routes.summary: Flexible undergraduate computing route open to students from Science, Commerce, or Arts, with option to enter tech jobs directly or pursue MCA for equivalence.
routes.suitability: Ideal for students who want to become software developers without clearing engineering entrances like JEE.

steps.course: Class 11 & 12 in Any Recognised Stream (Science, Commerce with Math/IP, or Arts)
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 with minimum 50% aggregate. (Note: Many universities require Mathematics or Informatics Practices in Class 12 for BCA eligibility; verify institution criteria).
steps.whatToDo: Focus on Class 12 board marks and basic computing logic. If possible, choose Mathematics or Computer Science / IP as an elective subject.

steps.course: BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications) or B.Sc (Computer Science / IT)
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 with required subjects and merit / university entrance score.
steps.whatToDo: Learn modern programming stacks (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, React, Node.js). Build independent web applications, open source contributions, and personal portfolio.

steps.course: Direct Junior Software Developer Role OR 2-Year MCA (for B.Tech Equivalence)
steps.eligibility: For MCA: Pass BCA/B.Sc with Mathematics at 10+2 or degree level + NIMCET / MAH-MCA-CET rank.
steps.whatToDo: Option 1: Apply directly for frontend, backend, or full-stack software developer jobs using portfolio. Option 2: Clear NIMCET/State CET to enter premier NITs for MCA, unlocking top product company campus drives.

factors.routeA: After Class 10 (School 11-12)

factors.name: Initial Step
factors.routeA: Class 11-12 Science (PCM)

factors.name: Undergraduate Degree
factors.routeA: 4-Year B.E. / B.Tech

factors.routeA: 6 Years (2 yrs + 4 yrs)

factors.routeB: Lateral entry depends on state quotas & merit cutoffs
factors.routeC: Maths at 10+2 often required by top universities

factors.name: Main Advantage
factors.routeA: Widest college brand choices, direct access to IITs/NITs
factors.routeB: Hands-on coding from age 16; bypasses JEE competition
factors.routeC: Lower entrance pressure; rapid 3-year path to industry

routes.name: Route A: Science PCM → Top Engineering Degree (JEE / State CET)
routes.summary: Target high ranks in JEE Main and State CET during Class 11-12 to secure Computer Science in premier government and tier-1 institutions.

steps.course: Class 11 Science PCM Master Syllabus
steps.eligibility: Currently enrolled in Class 11 Science with PCM.
steps.whatToDo: Focus intensely on Class 11 mechanics, calculus, chemical bonding, and coordinate geometry. Class 11 carries 45-50% weightage in JEE Main and CET. Avoid conceptual backlogs.

steps.course: Class 12 Boards (Target 75%+) + JEE Main & State CETs
steps.eligibility: Must clear Class 12 board with Physics, Chemistry, Math and min 75% (JoSAA) or 50% (State CET).
steps.whatToDo: Appear for JEE Main Session 1 (Jan) and Session 2 (April), followed by state CETs in May. Complete board examinations with high marks.

steps.course: 4-Year B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science / IT / AI-DS
steps.eligibility: Valid rank in JEE Main or State CET through centralized counselling.
steps.whatToDo: Complete foundational CS courses, solve 300+ LeetCode DSA problems, build full-stack projects, and participate in hackathons.

steps.course: Software Development Engineer (SDE-1) at Tech Companies / Startups
steps.eligibility: Graduating engineer with verified technical skills and project portfolio.
steps.whatToDo: Interview for product and service software engineering roles through campus placement or open job portals.

routes.name: Route B: Alternative Computing Degree (BCA / B.Sc CS) → Software Role or MCA
routes.summary: Focus Class 11-12 on core academics, then pursue 3-year BCA with dedicated practical coding, entering software roles directly or via MCA.

steps.course: Class 11 Coursework + Foundational Coding Self-Study
steps.eligibility: Enrolled in Class 11 (Any stream, preferably with Math or Computer Science / IP).
steps.whatToDo: Maintain good school grades while learning basic Python or web development (HTML/CSS/JS) online for 3-4 hours per week.

steps.course: Complete Class 12 Boards + Register for BCA / B.Sc CS Admissions
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 with 50%+ aggregate.
steps.whatToDo: Appear for university admission tests and apply to top BCA colleges in your region.

steps.course: 3-Year BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications)
steps.eligibility: Merit or CET score in affiliated university.
steps.whatToDo: Build full-stack web applications, mobile apps, and contribute to GitHub projects. Apply for tech internships in year 2 and 3.

steps.course: Junior Software Developer OR 2-Year MCA (NIMCET / State CET)
steps.eligibility: BCA graduate with project portfolio or valid NIMCET score.
steps.whatToDo: Take up campus placement offers in tech consulting/SaaS companies or clear NIMCET for MCA at National Institutes of Technology.

routes.name: Route A: Class 12 Boards + JEE/CET → 4-Year B.Tech in Computer Science
routes.summary: Immediate post-Class 12 pathway into 4-year engineering through upcoming national and state entrance examinations.

steps.course: Class 12 Board Exams + National Engineering Entrances
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Math. Score min 75% for IIT/NIT/IIIT JoSAA admission, or 50% for state CETs.
steps.whatToDo: Complete board syllabus revision, practice mock test papers under timed conditions, register for JEE Main Sessions 1 & 2, and fill state CET application forms.

steps.course: JoSAA / CSAB / State DTE Centralized Admission Process (CAP)
steps.eligibility: Valid percentile/rank in JEE Main or State CET.
steps.whatToDo: Fill preferred colleges and Computer Engineering / IT / AI branches in option form, verify documents, and confirm admission.

steps.course: 4-Year B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science & Engineering
steps.eligibility: Admitted to AICTE recognized engineering college.
steps.whatToDo: Master Data Structures, Algorithms, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, and Full-Stack Engineering. Maintain 7.5+ CGPA and complete summer internships.

steps.course: Full-Time Software Engineer / SDE-1
steps.eligibility: B.Tech in CS/IT or related field with proven programming competence.
steps.whatToDo: Accept campus placement offer or apply to technology companies, SaaS startups, and multinational product engineering firms.

routes.name: Route B: Class 12 → BCA / B.Sc Computer Science → Software Developer
routes.summary: Immediate admission into 3-year BCA or B.Sc CS based on Class 12 board marks or CUET-UG, bypassing JEE competition.

steps.course: Complete Class 12 + Apply for BCA / B.Sc CS Admissions
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 with 50%+ aggregate in any stream (Mathematics/IP at 10+2 preferred/required by several universities; check specific college criteria).
steps.whatToDo: Focus on high Class 12 percentage, register for CUET-UG / state BCA CET, and apply to top university colleges.

steps.course: 3-Year Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)
steps.eligibility: Admitted to UGC recognized university.
steps.whatToDo: Build an impressive GitHub portfolio with real web and mobile apps. Learn modern tech stacks (React, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL) beyond classroom curriculum.

steps.stage: Direct Tech Placement OR NIMCET / MCA
steps.course: Full-Time Junior Software Engineer OR 2-Year MCA at NITs
steps.eligibility: For MCA: BCA/B.Sc degree + NIMCET or State CET rank.
steps.whatToDo: Secure campus placement in IT service/consulting companies, or crack NIMCET for admission into National Institutes of Technology for MCA.

routes.name: Statutory Allopathic Medical Pathway: 11-12 (PCB) → NEET-UG → MBBS → Licensing
routes.summary: The ONLY statutory and legally recognized pathway in India to become an Allopathic Medical Doctor (MBBS). No diploma or alternative shortcut exists.
routes.suitability: Mandatory for any student aiming to practice allopathic clinical medicine and surgery in India.

steps.course: Class 10 Board Examination
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 10 with strong interest and foundation in Science (Biology, Chemistry, Physics).
steps.whatToDo: Enroll in Class 11 Science with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB). Mathematics may be taken as an optional 4th subject (PCMB) for added backup.

steps.course: Class 11 & 12 Science with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB)
steps.eligibility: Must pass Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English with minimum 50% aggregate in PCB (40% for SC/ST/OBC). Must complete minimum 17 years of age on or before December 31 of admission year.

entranceExams.name: NEET-UG (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test conducted by NTA)

steps.whatToDo: Master NCERT Biology, Chemistry, and Physics line by line. Solve 10,000+ MCQs, practice timed 3-hour 20-minute mock tests, and register for NEET-UG.

steps.course: MCC All India Quota (15%) & State Quota (85%) Counselling
steps.eligibility: Qualify NEET-UG by scoring at or above the designated percentile cutoff (50th percentile for General, 40th for reserved categories).
steps.whatToDo: Register for Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) for AIIMS, JIPMER, and Central Universities, and State CET Cell for state government medical colleges.

steps.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)
steps.duration: 4.5 Years Academic Study + 1 Year Compulsory Rotatory Medical Internship (CRMI)
steps.eligibility: Allotted seat through NEET-UG counselling in NMC-recognized medical college.
steps.whatToDo: Study Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry, Pathology, Pharmacology, Microbiology, Forensic Medicine, Community Medicine, Ophthalmology, ENT, Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, and Paediatrics. Complete 1 year compulsory rotatory clinical hospital internship.

steps.course: State Medical Council Registration + NExT / NEET-PG for MD/MS
steps.eligibility: Successful completion of MBBS and CRMI + qualification in National Exit Test (NExT).
steps.whatToDo: Obtain permanent statutory registration from State Medical Council / NMC to practice as Registered Medical Practitioner (RMP). Crack NExT/NEET-PG for specialist residency (MD in Medicine, Paediatrics, Radiology or MS in General Surgery, Orthopaedics).

factors.name: Statutory Authority
factors.routeA: National Medical Commission (NMC)

factors.name: Starting Point
factors.routeA: Class 10 completion

factors.name: Compulsory School Stream
factors.routeA: Class 11-12 Science with PCB (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) & English

factors.name: Mandatory Entrance Exam
factors.routeA: NEET-UG (Conducted pan-India by NTA)

factors.name: Total Course Duration
factors.routeA: 5.5 Years (4.5 Years Academic + 1 Year Mandatory Hospital Internship)

factors.name: Shortcut / Diploma Availability
factors.routeA: NO shortcut or diploma pathway exists to become an allopathic doctor under Indian law

factors.name: Statutory Registration
factors.routeA: Mandatory registration with State Medical Council / NMC to obtain RMP license

routes.name: Class 11 Focus → NEET-UG → MBBS Professional Degree
routes.summary: Consolidate Class 11 biology, chemistry, and physics foundations, followed by Class 12 board clearance and NEET-UG rank.

steps.course: Class 11 PCB NCERT Syllabus & Daily MCQ Practice
steps.eligibility: Enrolled in Class 11 Science with PCB.
steps.whatToDo: Class 11 covers nearly half the NEET-UG paper (Plant & Human Physiology, Cell Biology, Thermodynamics, Mechanics). Solve NCERT exemplar problems and take topic tests.

steps.course: Class 12 Boards (Min 50% in PCB) + NEET-UG Examination
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English with min 50% aggregate in PCB (40% for reserved categories).
steps.whatToDo: Appear for Class 12 board examinations and sit for NEET-UG conducted nationwide in May.

steps.course: Bachelor of Medicine & Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)
steps.eligibility: Qualify NEET-UG with competitive merit percentile.
steps.whatToDo: Undergo rigorous preclinical, paraclinical, and clinical hospital rotations. Complete 1 year compulsory rotatory internship.

steps.course: Registered Medical Practitioner (RMP) / MD/MS Residency
steps.eligibility: MBBS completion + National Exit Test (NExT).
steps.whatToDo: Register with State Medical Council and pursue postgraduate residency in chosen medical specialty.

routes.name: Immediate: Class 12 PCB → NEET-UG → MBBS Medical Degree
routes.summary: Immediate post-Class 12 statutory medical admission pathway via upcoming NEET-UG examination and MCC counselling.

steps.course: Class 12 Board Exams + NEET-UG Final Preparation
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English with min 50% in PCB (40% for SC/ST/OBC). Age 17+.
steps.whatToDo: Clear Class 12 board examinations and take full-length NEET-UG mock test papers. Revise high-weightage chapters in Biology and Organic Chemistry.

steps.course: MCC All India Quota & State CET Medical Counselling
steps.eligibility: Qualifying score in NEET-UG.
steps.whatToDo: Register on MCC (mcc.nic.in) for 15% All India Quota seats (AIIMS, JIPMER, Central Universities) and State Counselling for 85% state quota seats.

steps.course: Bachelor of Medicine & Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)
steps.eligibility: Allotted seat in recognized medical college.
steps.whatToDo: Complete classroom theory, clinical bed-side teaching, hospital night duties, and 1 year compulsory rotatory internship.

steps.course: Statutory Medical License + Specialist MD/MS/DNB
steps.eligibility: MBBS completion + NExT examination clearance.
steps.whatToDo: Obtain permanent medical license to practice in India and apply for postgraduate clinical specialisation.

routes.name: Route A: School (11-12 Any Stream) → ICAI CA Foundation → Intermediate → Articleship → Final
routes.summary: Standard ICAI pathway allowing students to register for CA Foundation after Class 10 and appear immediately after passing Class 12.
routes.suitability: Commerce stream is helpful but ICAI permits students from ANY 10+2 stream (Science, Arts, Commerce) to qualify.

steps.course: Pass Class 10 + Provisional ICAI CA Foundation Registration
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 10 board examination. ICAI allows provisional registration for CA Foundation after 10th.
steps.whatToDo: Enroll in Class 11 (preferably Commerce with Math or IP, though Science/Arts is also permitted). Register provisionally with ICAI on the Self Service Portal (SSP).

steps.course: Complete Class 11-12 + Prepare 4 Foundation Papers
steps.eligibility: Must pass Class 12 board examination in any stream recognized by Central/State govt.

entranceExams.name: ICAI CA Foundation Examination (Held in June / Dec or Jan / May)

steps.whatToDo: Study Accounting, Business Laws, Quantitative Aptitude (Maths, Stats, Logical Reasoning), and Business Economics. Appear for CA Foundation after Class 12 boards.

steps.stage: CA Intermediate & Integrated IT / Soft Skills
steps.course: CA Intermediate (Group 1 & Group 2 - 6 Papers) + ICITSS Training
steps.eligibility: Pass CA Foundation with minimum 40% in each paper and 50% aggregate.
steps.whatToDo: Clear Group 1 and Group 2 papers covering Advanced Accounting, Corporate Laws, Taxation (Direct & Indirect GST), Cost & Management Accounting, and Auditing. Complete mandatory 4-week ICITSS training (Information Technology & Soft Skills).

steps.course: 2-Year Full-Time Practical Training (Articleship) under a Practicing Chartered Accountant
steps.eligibility: Pass BOTH Group 1 and Group 2 of CA Intermediate + complete ICITSS.
steps.whatToDo: Work full-time in an authorized CA audit firm gaining real-world experience in statutory audit, tax filing, internal controls, and client corporate compliance.

steps.course: CA Final (Group 1 & Group 2) + AICITSS + ICAI Membership
steps.eligibility: Complete mandatory articleship training + qualify CA Intermediate.
steps.whatToDo: Clear CA Final papers: Financial Reporting, Advanced Financial Management, Advanced Auditing, Direct Tax Laws & International Taxation, Indirect Tax Laws, and Integrated Business Solutions. Apply for ICAI Associate Membership (ACA).

routes.name: Route B: Graduation Degree (B.Com / BBA / B.Tech) → Direct Entry to CA Intermediate
routes.summary: Skip CA Foundation entirely by graduating first with minimum prescribed marks, entering straight into CA Intermediate.
routes.suitability: Ideal for students who want a standard college campus experience first before tackling professional exams.

steps.course: Class 11-12 + 3-Year B.Com, BBA, or Any Graduate Degree
steps.eligibility: Commerce graduates require min 55% marks; Non-commerce graduates (Science/Arts/Engg) require min 60% aggregate.
steps.whatToDo: Complete undergraduate degree from any recognized UGC university with the required percentage threshold.

steps.course: Register Directly for CA Intermediate (No CA Foundation needed)
steps.eligibility: Graduation with 55% (Commerce) or 60% (Other streams).
steps.whatToDo: Register with ICAI under Direct Entry Scheme, complete ICITSS orientation course, and prepare for Intermediate exams.

steps.course: CA Intermediate Exams → 2-Year Articleship → CA Final
steps.eligibility: Pass Intermediate groups and complete articleship.
steps.whatToDo: Clear Intermediate exams, complete 2-year practical training, and pass CA Final to become a certified Chartered Accountant.

factors.routeB: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)

factors.routeA: Immediately after Class 10 (Provisional registration)

factors.routeA: 21 - 23 Years (Fastest route)

factors.name: College Experience
factors.routeA: Often done via correspondence or local college
factors.routeB: Full 3-year campus college degree experience first

routes.name: Class 11 Focus → CA Foundation after 12th → Intermediate & Articleship
routes.summary: Master Class 11 accountancy and economics, clear 12th boards, and sit for CA Foundation immediately.

steps.course: Class 11 Accountancy, Economics & Business Math
steps.eligibility: Enrolled in Class 11.
steps.whatToDo: Master Journal entries, Ledger posting, Trial balance, Financial statements, and Microeconomics. Register provisionally on ICAI SSP portal.

steps.course: Class 12 Board Exams + ICAI CA Foundation Exam
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 in any recognized stream.
steps.whatToDo: Complete board examinations in March, then appear for CA Foundation examination.

steps.course: CA Intermediate (6 Papers) + 2-Year Practical Articleship
steps.eligibility: Pass CA Foundation with 50% aggregate.
steps.whatToDo: Clear Intermediate groups, complete ICITSS, and serve 2-year articleship at a registered audit firm.

steps.course: CA Final Examination + ICAI Membership
steps.eligibility: Complete articleship and clear CA Final.
steps.whatToDo: Clear CA Final papers to become an Associate Member of ICAI (ACA).

routes.name: Immediate: Class 12 Boards → CA Foundation (June/Jan) → Intermediate
routes.summary: Immediate post-Class 12 entry into the ICAI Chartered Accountancy course.

steps.course: Complete Class 12 Boards + Formal CA Foundation Exam
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 examination in any stream.
steps.whatToDo: Complete Class 12 board exams, register for the upcoming CA Foundation exam cycle, and study the 4 Foundation papers.

steps.course: CA Intermediate (6 Papers in 2 Groups)
steps.eligibility: Pass CA Foundation with 40% per subject and 50% aggregate.
steps.whatToDo: Enroll for CA Intermediate, complete mandatory ICITSS IT and soft skills training, and clear Group 1 and 2.

steps.course: Full-Time Practical Training under Practicing CA
steps.eligibility: Pass both groups of CA Intermediate.
steps.whatToDo: Execute audits, corporate compliance, and tax filings at an authorized chartered accountancy firm.

steps.course: CA Final Examination + ACA Designation
steps.eligibility: Complete articleship + pass CA Final.
steps.whatToDo: Pass CA Final examinations and enroll as an Associate Chartered Accountant.

design-creative.title: Design, User Experience & Creative Visual Arts

routes.name: Route A: School (11-12 Any Stream) → Design Entrance (UCEED/NID) → 4-Year B.Des Degree
routes.summary: Premier academic route into National Institutes of Design (NID), IIT Design Departments (IDC), and top private design universities.
routes.suitability: Ideal for students seeking comprehensive visual, interaction, or industrial design education with top campus recruitments.

steps.course: Class 10 Board Examination
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 10 with interest in drawing, visualization, or digital media.
steps.whatToDo: Choose any Class 11-12 stream (Arts, Commerce, or Science). Science with PCM is only required if targeting B.Des at IIT Bombay/IIT Delhi via UCEED, while other NID/NIFT/private campuses accept all streams.

steps.course: Class 11 & 12 + Daily Sketching & Design Aptitude Prep
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 in any stream from a recognized board.

entranceExams.name: UCEED (Undergraduate Common Entrance Examination for Design - IITs)
NID DAT (Design Aptitude Test - Prelims & Mains)

steps.whatToDo: Practice perspective drawing, human figures, color theory, problem identification, and visual storytelling. Appear for UCEED and NID DAT in January of Class 12.

steps.course: 4-Year B.Des (Bachelor of Design) in UI/UX / Communication / Product Design
steps.eligibility: Qualified rank in UCEED / NID DAT / University Studio Test.
steps.whatToDo: Master design systems, wireframing, user research, typography, Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, and 3D modeling. Complete 2 industry design internships.

steps.course: Design Portfolio Showcase (Behance / Dribbble / Personal Website)
steps.eligibility: Completed B.Des degree with 3-4 detailed UX case studies.
steps.whatToDo: Interview for UI/UX Designer, Product Designer, or Visual Design roles in tech product companies and design consultancies.

routes.name: Route B: Polytechnic / Vocational Diploma in Graphic/Web Design (Direct after 10th)
routes.summary: Practical hands-on technical diploma directly after Class 10 focusing on commercial design tools, digital media, and entry-level studio roles.
routes.suitability: Ideal for students who want immediate vocational design skills without 10+2 academic theory.

steps.course: Class 10 Board Examination
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 10 with minimum 35-50% marks.
steps.whatToDo: Apply for a 2-3 Year Diploma in Applied Art / Commercial Graphic Design / Web Design at state polytechnics or recognized vocational boards.

steps.course: 2 to 3-Year Diploma in Graphic Design / Multimedia / Digital Animation
steps.eligibility: Class 10 merit admission into polytechnic / vocational institute.
steps.whatToDo: Learn Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, HTML/CSS, branding typography, and digital video editing. Build client identity projects.

steps.stage: Studio Role OR Lateral Entry B.Des
steps.course: Junior Graphic/UI Designer in Digital Agency OR Lateral Entry into Degree
steps.eligibility: Diploma completion with verified design portfolio.
steps.whatToDo: Join digital advertising agencies, creative studios, or pursue lateral entry into 2nd year B.Des / B.Voc programs.

factors.name: Starting Point
factors.routeA: After Class 10 (via 11-12 School)

factors.name: Education Pathway
factors.routeA: 10+2 School → 4-Year B.Des Degree

factors.name: Entrance Exam
factors.routeA: UCEED / NID DAT / NIFT / Private Aptitude

factors.name: Key Competencies
factors.routeA: System design, design thinking, UX research, strategy

factors.name: Target Job Level
factors.routeA: Product Designer / Senior UI-UX / Design Strategist
factors.routeB: Junior Graphic Designer / Visual Production Artist

routes.name: Class 11 Focus → Design Entrances (UCEED/NID) → 4-Year B.Des Degree
routes.summary: Start sketching and building a design portfolio in Class 11 while completing 10+2 in any stream.

steps.course: Class 11 Academic Stream + Daily Sketching Practice
steps.eligibility: Enrolled in Class 11 (Any stream).
steps.whatToDo: Practice daily live sketching, perspective drawing, observation studies, and creative problem solving. Learn basics of Figma.

steps.course: Class 12 Boards + UCEED / NID DAT Exams
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 in any stream from recognized board.
steps.whatToDo: Clear Class 12 boards and appear for national design entrance exams in January-April.

steps.course: 4-Year Bachelor of Design (B.Des)
steps.eligibility: Allotted seat in NID, IIT IDC, or top design college.
steps.whatToDo: Specialize in UI/UX or Communication Design, build 3 end-to-end case studies, and interview for tech product design roles.

routes.name: Immediate: Class 12 Boards → UCEED / NID / B.Des Admissions
routes.summary: Immediate application to 4-year B.Des programs in premier government and private design colleges.

steps.course: Class 12 Boards + Design Entrance Tests
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 in any stream from recognized board.
steps.whatToDo: Complete board examinations, submit design test applications, and compile a portfolio of 10-15 best creative works.

steps.course: Bachelor of Design (B.Des) in UI/UX or Interaction Design
steps.eligibility: Merit or test score in recognized design institute.
steps.whatToDo: Master user experience design, interaction architecture, wireframes, user testing, and frontend collaboration.

steps.course: Product Designer / UI-UX Specialist at Tech Companies
steps.eligibility: B.Des graduate with public portfolio (Behance / Dribbble / Portfolio site).
steps.whatToDo: Join tech companies, SaaS startups, or global design consultancies building digital product interfaces.

law-advocacy.title: Law, Judicial Advocacy & Corporate Legal Counsel

routes.name: Route A: School (11-12 Any Stream) → CLAT / AILET → 5-Year Integrated Law (BA LLB / BBA LLB)
routes.summary: Direct entry right after Class 12 into premier National Law Universities (NLUs) through the Common Law Admission Test (CLAT).
routes.suitability: The gold standard for litigation advocates, corporate counsel, and judicial services aspirants.

steps.course: Class 10 Board Examination
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 10 with good reading comprehension and analytical ability.
steps.whatToDo: Enroll in Class 11 in any stream (Humanities/Arts, Commerce, or Science). Humanities with Political Science & History is popular, but all streams are equally eligible.

steps.course: Class 11 & 12 + CLAT & AILET Entrance Preparation
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 with minimum 45% aggregate (40% for SC/ST). No upper age limit for CLAT.
steps.whatToDo: Develop fast reading speed (newspapers, editorial analysis), critical reasoning, legal aptitude, and current affairs. Appear for CLAT in December of Class 12.

steps.course: 5-Year Integrated B.A. LL.B. (Hons) / B.B.A. LL.B. (Hons)
steps.eligibility: Allotted seat in National Law University or BCI-approved law college via CLAT/CET rank.
steps.whatToDo: Study Constitutional Law, Criminal Law (BNS), Civil Procedure, Corporate Law, Intellectual Property, and International Law. Participate actively in moot courts and internships.

steps.course: State Bar Council Enrollment + All India Bar Examination (AIBE)
steps.eligibility: Law graduate from BCI recognized institution.

entranceExams.name: AIBE (All India Bar Examination conducted by BCI)

steps.whatToDo: Enroll provisionally with State Bar Council, clear AIBE within 2 years to obtain permanent Certificate of Practice (COP), and begin court litigation or corporate legal practice.

routes.name: Route B: Graduation in Any Discipline (3 Yrs) → 3-Year LL.B. Degree
routes.summary: Complete any Bachelor's degree (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com., B.Tech.) first, then pursue a 3-Year LL.B. at prestigious university faculties (e.g., Delhi University, GLC Mumbai, ILS Pune).
routes.suitability: Ideal for students who discover an interest in law during college or want specialized technical/commercial background before law.

steps.course: Class 11-12 + Any 3 or 4-Year Bachelor's Degree (BA / B.Com / B.Sc / B.Tech)
steps.eligibility: Pass graduation with minimum 45-50% aggregate.
steps.whatToDo: Complete undergraduate degree with strong academic grades while participating in debates and student governance.

steps.course: CUET-PG (for DU Law Faculty) / MH-CET Law (3-Year) / State Entrances
steps.eligibility: Recognized Bachelor's degree with minimum 45% marks.

entranceExams.name: CUET-PG (Delhi University Faculty of Law / BHU)

steps.whatToDo: Clear entrance examination and secure admission to top university law faculty.

steps.course: 3-Year LL.B. + Bar Council Enrollment + AIBE
steps.eligibility: Law graduation from BCI approved law faculty.
steps.whatToDo: Complete 3-year core law curriculum, intern under senior advocates, and clear AIBE for license to practice.

factors.name: Starting Point
factors.routeA: Immediately after Class 12 (5-Year Route)
factors.routeB: After Completing Any Bachelor's Degree (3-Year Route)

factors.name: Degree Awarded
factors.routeA: Integrated BA LL.B. (Hons) / BBA LL.B. (Hons)

factors.name: Total Time Post-12th
factors.routeA: 5 Years total
factors.routeB: 6 - 7 Years total (3-4 yrs graduation + 3 yrs LL.B.)

factors.name: Primary Entrance Exam
factors.routeA: CLAT / AILET / MH-CET Law (5-Year)

factors.name: Top Target Institutes
factors.routeA: NLSIU Bangalore, NALSAR Hyderabad, WBNUJS Kolkata
factors.routeB: Faculty of Law DU, GLC Mumbai, ILS Pune, BHU

factors.name: Bar Council License
factors.routeA: Both routes lead to identical BCI Advocate license upon clearing AIBE
factors.routeB: Both routes lead to identical BCI Advocate license upon clearing AIBE

routes.name: Class 11 Focus → CLAT in Class 12 → 5-Year Integrated Law at NLUs
routes.summary: Begin reading habits and CLAT preparation right now in Class 11, appearing for CLAT in December of Class 12.

steps.course: Class 11 School Curriculum + Daily Newspaper & Critical Reasoning
steps.eligibility: Enrolled in Class 11 (Any stream).
steps.whatToDo: Read national newspapers (The Hindu / Indian Express editorials daily). Build reading speed of 300+ words per minute and solve critical reasoning passages.

steps.course: Class 12 Boards + CLAT (December) & AILET
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 with min 45% marks.
steps.whatToDo: Take CLAT mock tests, master legal passage reasoning, and secure high All India Rank (AIR) for top NLUs.

steps.course: 5-Year B.A. LL.B. (Hons) at National Law University
steps.eligibility: Allotted seat in NLU via CLAT merit rank.
steps.whatToDo: Engage in national moot courts, legal aid clinics, and internships at law firms and High Courts.

steps.course: State Bar Council COP + Corporate Law / Litigation
steps.eligibility: LL.B. degree + AIBE clearance.
steps.whatToDo: Join top law firms (Tier-1 firms like CAM, SAM, Trilegal) or practice under senior advocates in High Court/Supreme Court.

routes.name: Immediate: Class 12 Boards → CLAT / AILET / MH-CET Law → 5-Year Integrated LLB
routes.summary: Immediate post-Class 12 application to 5-year integrated law programs at National Law Universities and state law colleges.

steps.course: Class 12 Board Exams + Law Entrance Exams
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 in any stream with min 45% aggregate (40% for SC/ST).
steps.whatToDo: Complete board examinations, take CLAT/CET entrance tests, and register for law seat allocation counselling.

steps.course: 5-Year Integrated B.A. LL.B. / B.B.A. LL.B.
steps.eligibility: Admitted to BCI-approved law college or NLU.
steps.whatToDo: Study substantive and procedural laws, participate in national moot courts, and intern with law firms and advocates.

steps.course: All India Bar Examination (AIBE) + Certificate of Practice
steps.eligibility: LL.B. graduate.
steps.whatToDo: Enroll as an Advocate with State Bar Council, clear AIBE, and practice in court or join corporate legal teams.

civil-services.title: Civil Services & Public Administration (IAS / IPS / IFS)

routes.name: Standard UPSC Route: School (11-12 Any Stream) → Any Recognized Bachelor's Degree → UPSC CSE
routes.summary: UPSC Civil Services Examination requires ANY recognized graduation degree. No specific stream is compulsory.
routes.suitability: Ideal for students passionate about public governance, district administration, policing, and nationwide policy.

steps.course: Class 10 Board Examination
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 10 with interest in social sciences, current events, and public affairs.
steps.whatToDo: Enroll in Class 11. Humanities/Arts (History, Pol Science, Geography) directly builds the General Studies base, while Science or Commerce provides strong technical backup options.

steps.course: Class 11 & 12 School Curriculum + NCERT Reading
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 in any stream from recognized board.
steps.whatToDo: Excel in Class 12 boards. Read Class 6-12 NCERT textbooks in History, Geography, Polity, and Economics to build civil services foundational awareness.

steps.course: Any 3 or 4-Year Bachelor's Degree (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com., B.Tech., LL.B.)
steps.eligibility: Pass 10+2 and enroll in any UGC/AICTE recognized university degree.
steps.whatToDo: Maintain strong graduation marks while systematically studying UPSC General Studies syllabus, current affairs, newspaper analysis, and choosing an optional subject.

steps.course: UPSC CSE 3-Stage Selection (Prelims, Mains, Personality Test / Interview)
steps.eligibility: Indian citizen with recognized graduation degree. Minimum 21 years of age.

entranceExams.name: UPSC CSE Main Examination (9 Written Papers)

steps.whatToDo: Clear Preliminary Exam (objective), score high marks in 9 Mains subjective papers (Essay, GS 1-4, Optional 1-2), and clear the Personality Test at Dholpur House, New Delhi.

steps.course: Foundation Course at LBSNAA, Mussoorie + District Administration Cadre
steps.eligibility: Secured top merit rank in UPSC CSE for IAS / IPS / IFS.
steps.whatToDo: Undergo training at Lal Bahadur Shastri National Academy of Administration (LBSNAA) and SVPNPA Hyderabad, followed by posting as Assistant Collector / SDM / ASP.

factors.name: Statutory Authority
factors.routeA: Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) & DoPT

factors.name: Stream Restrictions
factors.routeA: NONE — Graduates from any stream (Arts, Science, Commerce, Engineering, Medicine) are equally eligible

factors.name: Minimum Educational Qualification
factors.routeA: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized university

factors.name: Minimum Age
factors.routeA: 21 Years on August 1 of the examination year

factors.name: Selection Stages
factors.routeA: Stage 1: Prelims (Objective) → Stage 2: Mains (9 Subjective Papers) → Stage 3: Interview / Personality Test

factors.name: Final Destination
factors.routeA: Indian Administrative Service (IAS) / Indian Police Service (IPS) Cadre Allocation

routes.name: Class 11 Focus → College Graduation + UPSC Civil Services Preparation
routes.summary: Build strong NCERT foundations in Class 11-12, complete a recognized Bachelor's degree, and appear for UPSC CSE at age 21.

steps.course: Class 11 Curriculum + NCERT History, Polity & Geography Reading
steps.eligibility: Enrolled in Class 11.
steps.whatToDo: Read standard NCERT textbooks and follow national current affairs through reputable newspapers.

steps.course: Complete Class 12 Boards + Enroll in Bachelor's Degree
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12.
steps.whatToDo: Score well in board exams and secure admission into a respected undergraduate college degree.

steps.course: 3 or 4-Year Bachelor's Degree + Systematic UPSC GS Preparation
steps.eligibility: Enrolled undergraduate student.
steps.whatToDo: Master UPSC syllabus, practice daily answer writing, and complete optional subject preparation.

steps.course: Prelims → Mains → Interview → LBSNAA Training
steps.eligibility: Graduate, age 21+.
steps.whatToDo: Clear all 3 stages of UPSC CSE to join the Indian Civil Services.

routes.name: Immediate: Class 12 Boards → Bachelor's Degree → UPSC CSE (IAS/IPS)
routes.summary: Enroll in an undergraduate degree right after Class 12 while building structured GS and optional subject preparation.

steps.course: Class 12 Board Exams + University Degree Admission
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 from recognized board.
steps.whatToDo: Clear Class 12 board examinations and enter a bachelor's degree program (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com., B.Tech., or Law).

steps.course: 3-Year or 4-Year Graduation + GS & Optional Preparation
steps.eligibility: College enrolled student.
steps.whatToDo: Read foundational standard books (Laxmikanth Polity, Spectrum History, Ramesh Singh Economics) and write daily practice answers.

steps.course: Prelims → Mains → Interview → Service Allocation
steps.eligibility: Graduate, age 21+.
steps.whatToDo: Appear for Prelims, Mains, and Interview to qualify for IAS, IPS, or IFS.

core-engineering.title: Core Engineering & Infrastructure (Mechanical / Civil / Electrical / Aerospace)

routes.name: Route A: School (11-12 Science PCM) → B.Tech / B.E. in Core Engineering
routes.summary: Standard academic route preparing for JEE Main, Advanced, and State CETs for admission to 4-year core engineering degrees.
routes.suitability: Ideal for students aiming for IITs, NITs, and top state engineering colleges with strong campus placement records.

steps.course: Class 10 Board Examination
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 10 with strong marks in Mathematics and Science.
steps.whatToDo: Enroll in Class 11 Science with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM).

steps.course: Class 11 & 12 Science (PCM)
steps.eligibility: Class 12 with PCM. Target min 75% for JoSAA / 50% for state CETs.
steps.whatToDo: Master mechanics, thermodynamics, electromagnetism, and calculus. Prepare for JEE and state CET.

steps.course: 4-Year B.Tech / B.E. (Mechanical / Civil / Electrical / Aerospace)
steps.eligibility: Valid rank in JEE Main or State CET counselling.
steps.whatToDo: Complete CAD/CAM design, finite element analysis, thermodynamics, structural design, and industrial internships.

steps.stage: Industry Core Placement / GATE for PSU & M.Tech
steps.course: Core Industry Engineer (L&T, Tata Motors, BHEL) OR GATE Examination
steps.eligibility: B.Tech/B.E. graduate.
steps.whatToDo: Join manufacturing, infrastructure, or aerospace firms, or crack GATE for PSU recruitments (IOCL, NTPC, ONGC) or IIT M.Tech.

routes.name: Route B: Polytechnic Diploma (3 Yrs) → Direct 2nd Year B.Tech (Lateral Entry)
routes.summary: Practical hands-on technical diploma right after Class 10, entering directly into 2nd year B.Tech via state lateral entry.
routes.suitability: Ideal for students seeking early mechanical workshop, electrical lab, and surveying experience without JEE stress.

steps.course: Pass Class 10 with Math & Science
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 10 with min 35-50% marks.
steps.whatToDo: Apply for 3-Year Polytechnic Engineering Diploma via State DTE CAP rounds.

steps.course: 3-Year Diploma in Mechanical / Civil / Electrical Engineering
steps.eligibility: Class 10 merit admission into MSBTE / AICTE approved polytechnic.
steps.whatToDo: Excel in workshop practice, machine drawing, surveying, circuitry, and maintain 75%+ in final diploma year.

steps.course: Direct Second Year (DSE) B.Tech Admission
steps.eligibility: Pass 3-year diploma with min 45% (40% for reserved category). Lateral entry quota is subject to state rules and seat availability.
steps.whatToDo: Register for DSE lateral entry counselling and enter directly into year 2 of B.E./B.Tech.

steps.course: Graduate Core Engineer
steps.eligibility: B.E./B.Tech completion.
steps.whatToDo: Join engineering consultancies, infrastructure developers, or automotive plants.

factors.name: Starting Point
factors.routeA: After Class 10 (via 11-12 School)

factors.name: Initial 2-3 Years
factors.routeA: Class 11-12 Science (PCM) with intense JEE/CET prep

factors.name: Degree Admission
factors.routeA: Enters 1st year B.Tech via JEE/CET rank
factors.routeB: Enters directly into 2nd year B.Tech via lateral entry

factors.name: Total Time to B.Tech
factors.routeA: 6 Years (2 yrs + 4 yrs)

factors.name: Key Advantage
factors.routeA: Access to IITs/NITs and theoretical depth
factors.routeB: Early hands-on workshop skills, bypasses JEE stress

routes.name: Class 11 Science PCM → JEE / State CET → 4-Year B.Tech in Core Engineering
routes.summary: Master core physical science principles in Class 11-12 and enter 4-year core engineering.

steps.course: Class 11 Physics, Chemistry & Math
steps.eligibility: Enrolled in Class 11 Science PCM.
steps.whatToDo: Build strong conceptual foundations in mechanics, thermodynamics, and calculus.

steps.course: Class 12 Boards + JEE Main / State CETs
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 with PCM.
steps.whatToDo: Appear for board exams and engineering entrance tests to secure top ranks.

steps.course: 4-Year B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical / Civil / Electrical / Aerospace
steps.eligibility: Admitted via CET rank.
steps.whatToDo: Complete lab coursework, CAD modeling, industrial internships, and major capstone design.

routes.name: Immediate: Class 12 Boards + JEE/CET → 4-Year Core Engineering Degree
routes.summary: Immediate post-Class 12 entry into mechanical, civil, electrical, or aerospace engineering.

steps.course: Class 12 Board Exams + JEE Main & State CETs
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 with PCM with min 75% for JoSAA / 50% for state CETs.
steps.whatToDo: Complete board exams, appear for entrance tests, and fill engineering option forms.

steps.course: 4-Year B.Tech in Core Engineering Branch
steps.eligibility: Admitted to AICTE recognized engineering college.
steps.whatToDo: Specialize in machine design, structural analysis, power electronics, or aerodynamics.

steps.stage: Industry Launch / PSU Career via GATE
steps.course: Core Industry Engineer / PSU Officer
steps.eligibility: B.Tech graduate.
steps.whatToDo: Secure campus placement in manufacturing/infrastructure companies or clear GATE for PSUs.

routes.name: Statutory DGCA Route: 11-12 Science (PCM) → Class 2 & 1 Medicals → Flying School (CPL 200 Hrs) → Airline Type Rating
routes.summary: The statutory Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) roadmap to earn a Commercial Pilot License (CPL).
routes.suitability: Mandatory for anyone aspiring to become a commercial airline pilot flying multi-engine passenger aircraft in India.

steps.course: Class 10 Board Examination
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 10 with strong vision, physical fitness, and affinity for aviation.
steps.whatToDo: Enroll in Class 11 Science with Physics and Mathematics (compulsory statutory requirement by DGCA).

steps.course: Class 11-12 Science (PCM) + DGCA Class 2 & Class 1 Medical Clearance
steps.eligibility: Must pass 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics (min 50%). Obtain Class 2 Medical certificate from DGCA-empaneled medical examiner, followed by Class 1 Medical at designated IAF medical centers.

entranceExams.name: IGRUA Entrance Examination (Optional for Govt Flying School)

steps.whatToDo: Clear Class 12 PCM boards and secure DGCA Class 1 Medical Fitness certificate. Obtain Computer Number from DGCA Pariksha portal.

steps.course: 200 Flying Hours at DGCA-Approved Flying Training Organisation (FTO)
steps.eligibility: Minimum 17 years old + Class 1 Medical Fitness + 10+2 PCM pass.

entranceExams.name: DGCA CPL Theory Exams (Air Navigation, Meteorology, Air Regulations, Technical General/Specific)
RTR(A) Exam by Ministry of Communications (WPC)

steps.whatToDo: Log 200 hours flight training (solo, cross-country, night flying, instrument flying). Pass all 5 DGCA ground theory exams and RTR(A) wireless telephony license.

steps.stage: CPL License Issuance & Airline Type Rating
steps.course: Commercial Pilot License (CPL-ME-IR) + Multi-Engine Jet Type Rating (A320 / B737)
steps.eligibility: Hold valid DGCA CPL with Multi-Engine and Instrument Rating.
steps.whatToDo: Receive statutory CPL from DGCA. Complete multi-crew cooperation (MCC) and aircraft type rating simulator training (Airbus A320 or Boeing 737) at approved ATO.

steps.course: Junior First Officer with Commercial Airline (IndiGo, Air India, SpiceJet, Akasa)
steps.eligibility: CPL + Type Rating + Airline Pilot Selection Assessment clearance.
steps.whatToDo: Pass airline psychomotor, compass, and simulator assessment rounds. Complete airline line training to fly passenger commercial flights.

factors.routeA: Minimum 200 total verified flight hours at approved Flying Training Organization

routes.name: Class 11 Focus → DGCA Medicals in 12th → Flying School & CPL

steps.course: Class 11 Physics and Mathematics Mastery
steps.eligibility: Enrolled in Class 11 Science with PCM.
steps.whatToDo: Excel in physics vectors, thermodynamics, kinematics, and trigonometry required for aviation ground school.

steps.course: Class 12 Boards + DGCA Class 2 and Class 1 Medical Clearance
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 with Physics and Mathematics.
steps.whatToDo: Pass Class 12 boards with 50%+ in Physics and Math, clear DGCA Class 1 Medical examination, and get a DGCA computer number.

steps.course: Commercial Pilot License at DGCA Flying Training Organization
steps.eligibility: Age 17+, Class 1 Medical, 10+2 PCM.
steps.whatToDo: Log 200 flying hours, clear 5 DGCA ground exams, and earn Commercial Pilot License.

routes.name: Immediate: Class 12 PCM → DGCA Class 1 Medical → Flying Training & CPL
routes.summary: Immediate post-Class 12 pathway into commercial aviation and flight training.

steps.course: Class 12 Boards (Physics & Math) + DGCA Class 2/1 Medical Examinations
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 with Physics & Math (min 50%). Class 1 Medical fitness.
steps.whatToDo: Clear Class 12 boards, obtain DGCA Class 1 Medical certificate, apply for DGCA Computer Number, and choose an approved FTO.

steps.course: 200 Hours Flying + DGCA Ground School Exams
steps.eligibility: Enrolled student pilot with valid Student Pilot License (SPL).
steps.whatToDo: Complete solo, night, instrument, and cross-country flying checks. Clear DGCA papers and RTR(A) radio telephony exam.

steps.course: A320 / B737 Type Rating → Airline Induction
steps.eligibility: DGCA CPL holder.
steps.whatToDo: Complete type rating on commercial transport jet simulator and join airline cadet/first officer roster.

routes.name: Statutory Council of Architecture (COA) Route: 11-12 PCM → NATA / JEE Paper 2 → 5-Year B.Arch
routes.summary: The statutory pathway prescribed by the Council of Architecture (COA) to become a licensed Architect in India.
routes.suitability: Mandatory for anyone aspiring to sign architectural drawings and register with the Council of Architecture.

steps.course: Class 10 Board Examination
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 10 with strong interest in geometry, drawing, and structures.
steps.whatToDo: Enroll in Class 11 Science with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM). Note: Council of Architecture regulations mandate Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics at 10+2 level.

steps.course: Class 11-12 Science (PCM) + Architecture Drawing Prep
steps.eligibility: Pass 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics with minimum 50% aggregate (or 10+3 Diploma with Mathematics with 50%).

entranceExams.name: NATA (National Aptitude Test in Architecture conducted by COA)
JEE Main Paper 2 (B.Arch for SPAs, NITs, IITs)

steps.whatToDo: Master perspective sketching, architectural awareness, light & shade rendering, and 2D/3D composition. Appear for NATA or JEE Main Paper 2.

steps.course: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch)
steps.eligibility: Qualified score in NATA or JEE Main Paper 2 + fulfillment of 10+2 PCM criteria.
steps.whatToDo: Study Architectural Design Studios, Building Materials & Construction, History of Architecture, Climate Responsive Design, and Structural Mechanics. Complete 1 semester practical training in an architectural firm.

steps.course: COA Certificate of Registration (Architect CA Number)
steps.eligibility: Successful B.Arch graduation from COA recognized institution.
steps.whatToDo: Obtain statutory registration certificate from Council of Architecture to use the protected legal title 'Architect' and start independent practice or join architectural firms.

factors.name: Statutory Authority
factors.routeA: Council of Architecture (COA), Government of India

factors.name: School Stream Requirement
factors.routeA: Class 11-12 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) or 10+3 Diploma with Math

factors.name: Mandatory Architecture Entrances
factors.routeA: NATA (by COA) or JEE Main Paper 2 (for NITs/SPAs)

factors.name: Degree Duration
factors.routeA: 5 Years Full-Time (10 Semesters including mandatory office internship)

factors.name: Legal Protection of Title
factors.routeA: Under the Architects Act 1972, only individuals registered with COA can legally use the title 'Architect'

routes.name: Class 11 Science PCM → NATA / JEE Paper 2 → 5-Year B.Arch Degree
routes.summary: Build strong drawing, spatial visualization, and math foundations in Class 11, crack NATA, and complete 5-year B.Arch.

steps.course: Class 11 Science PCM + Architecture Drawing
steps.eligibility: Enrolled in Class 11 Science with PCM.
steps.whatToDo: Maintain solid marks in PCM while sketching daily: perspective layouts, urban scenes, shadow casting, and 3D geometric views.

steps.course: Class 12 Boards + Architecture Entrance Exams
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 with PCM with 50% aggregate.
steps.whatToDo: Clear Class 12 boards and appear for NATA and JEE Paper 2 for admission to School of Planning and Architecture (SPAs) and state architecture colleges.

steps.course: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch) + COA Registration
steps.eligibility: NATA / JEE Paper 2 rank in recognized college.
steps.whatToDo: Complete studio design projects, structural analysis, green building certifications, and register with COA.

routes.name: Immediate: Class 12 PCM → NATA / JEE Paper 2 → 5-Year B.Arch Program
routes.summary: Immediate post-Class 12 application to 5-year B.Arch programs through NATA and centralized admission.

steps.course: Class 12 Board Exams + NATA / JEE Paper 2
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, and Math with min 50% aggregate.
steps.whatToDo: Complete Class 12 board exams, register for NATA test dates, practice architectural aptitude questions, and participate in state CAP counselling.

steps.course: 5-Year Bachelor of Architecture Degree
steps.eligibility: Admitted to COA recognized architecture college.
steps.whatToDo: Undergo architectural studio training, building physics, climate design, urban planning, and 6-month architectural internship.

steps.course: Council of Architecture Registration (CA Number)
steps.eligibility: B.Arch completion.
steps.whatToDo: Receive statutory license to practice as an Architect and launch independent studio or join premier design firms.

routes.name: Route A: School (11-12 PCB/PCM) → 4-Year B.Pharm Degree → Registered Pharmacist
routes.summary: Statutory Pharmacy Council of India (PCI) route to become a Registered Pharmacist through a 4-year undergraduate B.Pharm degree.

steps.course: Class 10 Board Examination
steps.eligibility: Pass Class 10 with science and math foundation.
steps.whatToDo: Enroll in Class 11 Science with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (or Mathematics). Both PCB and PCM students are eligible for Pharmacy.

steps.course: Class 11 & 12 Science (PCB or PCM)
steps.eligibility: Pass 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Math with min 50% aggregate (45% for reserved category).

entranceExams.name: State Pharmacy CET (e.g. MHT-CET, KCET, WBJEE)

steps.whatToDo: Focus on Organic Chemistry and Human Physiology. Clear Class 12 boards and appear for State Pharmacy CET.

steps.course: 4-Year Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm)
steps.eligibility: Allotted seat in PCI-approved pharmacy college via CET rank.
steps.whatToDo: Study Pharmaceutics, Pharmacology, Medicinal Chemistry, Pharmacognosy, and Regulatory Affairs. Complete hospital and industrial pharmacy training.

steps.course: Registered Pharmacist License + Industry / Clinical Practice
steps.eligibility: B.Pharm graduation from PCI recognized institution.
steps.whatToDo: Register with State Pharmacy Council to obtain statutory license to practice, manufacture, or dispense pharmaceuticals.

routes.name: Route B: 2-Year Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm) → Lateral Entry to 2nd Year B.Pharm
routes.summary: Shorter practical diploma qualifying for retail chemist license, with option to enter 2nd year B.Pharm via lateral entry.

steps.course: Class 12 Science + 2-Year D.Pharm Diploma
steps.eligibility: Pass 10+2 Science (PCB or PCM).
steps.whatToDo: Enroll in 2-year D.Pharm covering dispensing pharmacy, pharmacology, and 500 hours hospital training.

steps.course: Direct Second Year B.Pharm
steps.eligibility: Pass D.Pharm with min 50% from PCI approved college.
steps.whatToDo: Join 2nd year B.Pharm directly to complete degree.

routes.name: Class 11 Science PCB/PCM → State CET → 4-Year B.Pharm Degree
routes.summary: Master chemistry and biology in Class 11-12 and crack state pharmacy CET.

steps.eligibility: Enrolled in Class 11 Science.

steps.course: Class 12 Boards + State Pharmacy CET

steps.course: 4-Year B.Pharm + Registered Pharmacist License
steps.eligibility: Allotted seat in recognized college.
steps.whatToDo: Complete degree and register with State Pharmacy Council.

routes.name: Immediate: Class 12 Boards → State Pharmacy CET → 4-Year B.Pharm Degree
routes.summary: Immediate post-Class 12 application to 4-year B.Pharm through state CET counselling.

steps.course: Class 12 Boards + State Pharmacy CET
